question: Complete the square to write \(2x^2-8x+1=0\) in the form \(2(x-m)^2=n\). Find the values of \(m\) and \(n\).
solution: \(2x^2-8x=-1\), so \(2(x^2-4x)=-1\). Adding 4 inside the parentheses and adding \(2\times4=8\) to the right-hand side gives \(2(x-2)^2=7\). Therefore, \(m=2\) and \(n=7\).
